# Nimbus weather app (code.in.30s)
Glassmorphism weather mobile app. A soft full-bleed gradient sky background, with frosted translucent glass cards on top (white at 18-26% opacity, backdrop blur 24px, 1px white border at 50% opacity, 28px radius, soft shadow). Huge thin temperature numerals (Sora, weight 200), bold Sora headings, small caps labels. Flat soft weather icons (sun, clouds, rain drops) drawn as simple shapes. ONE warm sun accent #FFB238 for highlights (sun icon, UV, active tab dot, primary button). AQI scale uses green #3DD68C, yellow #FFD54A, orange #FF8A3D. No photos, no people, no neon.
## Light (day, hero): sky gradient from #4FA3F7 (top) through #8CCBFF to warm horizon #FFD6A5 (bottom). Glass cards white 24% with white border. Ink deep navy #0F2A4A, muted #4D6A8C.

screens.prompt:
Create the mobile weather app screen for "Nimbus" in DAY mode with true glassmorphism styling, exactly tailored to a 390x844 viewport:

1. Color Palette & Background:
- Full-bleed soft daytime sky gradient from top to bottom: #4FA3F7 (sky blue top) -> #8CCBFF (mid blue) -> #FFD6A5 (warm soft peach horizon at bottom).
- Deep navy ink text: #0F2A4A for headings/primary text, muted #4D6A8C for secondary labels.
- Warm sun accent: #FFB238.

2. Frosted Glass Styling (Glassmorphism):
- Glass panels with 28px rounded corners (rounded-3xl / rounded-[28px]), backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl, background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) (white 24% opacity fill), 1px border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) (white 50% border), soft ambient drop shadow.

3. Screen Layout (CURRENT WEATHER HOME):
- Top App Bar / Header:
  * Left: Location pin icon with bold "Bengaluru" (font-bold text-lg text-[#0F2A4A]) and underneath small "Sat, 24 Oct" (text-xs font-medium text-[#4D6A8C]).
  * Right: Circular frosted glass menu button (w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/25 border border-white/50 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center text-[#0F2A4A] shadow-sm) with menu or grid icon.

- Center Hero Weather:
  * Visual: Soft 3D-ish stylized weather graphic featuring a vibrant golden-yellow sun (#FFB238) partly emerging from behind a clean, soft puffy white cloud with subtle layered volume and depth (using CSS/SVG soft shadows and gradients, no real photos/no maps).
  * Temperature: Huge thin numeral "27°" in font-light/extralight (Sora weight 200 style, text-7xl or text-8xl text-[#0F2A4A] tracking-tighter).
  * Weather status: Bold Sora heading "Partly cloudy" (text-lg font-semibold text-[#0F2A4A]) and underneath "H 30°  •  L 21°" in uppercase letter-spaced label (text-xs tracking-wider font-semibold text-[#4D6A8C]).

- Stat Row (Frosted Glass Card):
  * A 28px rounded frosted glass panel holding 3 stats evenly distributed with subtle vertical frosted dividers:
    1. Wind: 12 km/h (with air/wind icon)
    2. Humidity: 64% (with water drop icon)
    3. Rain: 20% (with umbrella/rain icon)
  * Stat values bold #0F2A4A, labels small uppercase letter-spaced #4D6A8C.

- Hourly Forecast (Frosted Glass Card):
  * Frosted glass card with header "Hourly Forecast" (small uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-[#4D6A8C] or bold Sora section title).
  * Horizontal row of 5 pill columns:
    1. "Now": 27°, warm sun icon, highlighted with a clean white/solid frosted fill (bg-white/50 or bg-white/70 shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-2.5 flex flex-col items-center)
    2. "13:00": 28°, sun icon
    3. "14:00": 29°, sun/cloud icon
    4. "15:00": 28°, cloud icon
    5. "16:00": 26°, cloud with rain drops icon
  * Each pill displaying time, weather icon, and temperature in clean readable hierarchy.

- Bottom Navigation:
  * Floating frosted glass pill navigation bar docked near the bottom: rounded-full bg-white/25 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/50 shadow-lg px-6 py-3 flex justify-between items-center max-w-[320px] mx-auto.
  * 4 line icons: Home, Forecast, Cities, Settings.
  * Home is active with a bright circular or pill indicator (e.g. bg-white/60 or accent circle with navy icon).

Ensure no overflow on 390x844, immaculate glassmorphic translucency, and premium modern finish.
screens.title: Nimbus - Current Weather

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Nimbus Weather** current weather home screen in Day mode, designed with a bespoke glassmorphism aesthetic:

### Design Highlights:
- **Atmospheric Day Sky Gradient**: A full-bleed background blending smoothly from crisp sky blue (`#4FA3F7`) through mid-blue (`#8CCBFF`) down to a warm horizon peach (`#FFD6A5`).
- **Frosted Glass Panels**: 28px rounded floating cards with 24% translucent white fill, 1px semi-transparent borders (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)`), backdrop blur, and soft ambient drop shadows.
- **Hero Temperature & Visuals**: A soft, stylized sun partly nestled behind a puffy cloud illustration, paired with an ultra-thin Sora-styled `27°` temperature numeral, "Partly cloudy" condition, and `H 30° • L 21°` range.
- **Quick Metrics Card**: Three-metric frosted glass row displaying Wind (`12 km/h`), Humidity (`64%`), and Rain chance (`20%`) with dedicated iconography and deep navy typography.
- **Hourly Forecast**: A horizontal card featuring 5 hourly forecast pills (`Now`, `13:00`, `14:00`, `15:00`, `16:00`), with the active "Now" column highlighted in a solid frosted treatment.
- **Floating Glass Nav**: A pill-shaped floating bottom bar featuring icons for Home, Forecast, Cities, and Settings, with an active state on Home.

The screen is optimized for a 390×844 mobile viewport.

screens.prompt:
Create the "Forecast" screen for the Nimbus mobile weather app in Day Mode, matching the visual language and style of {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_3}}.

Key Specifications & Layout (fit 390x844 mobile viewport):
- Background: Full-bleed soft sky gradient from vivid sky blue #4FA3F7 at top -> soft azure #8CCBFF -> warm golden peach horizon #FFD6A5 at bottom.
- Typography: Sora font family with Deep navy ink #0F2A4A for headings and key values, muted slate #4D6A8C for secondary labels/captions. Small uppercase tracking labels.
- Header:
  - Top bar with back/location icon or menu, bold headline "Forecast" (Sora bold), and search/more action.
  - Segmented frosted glass tab toggle: "Today" | "10 days" with "10 days" active (white glass pill highlight with subtle shadow, active text #0F2A4A font-semibold).
- Card 1: 24-Hour Temperature Trend Chart
  - Frosted glass panel: 28px rounded corners, white/24 fill (bg-white/24), backdrop-blur-xl, 1px white/50 border, soft ambient shadow.
  - Header: Small uppercase tracking label "24-HOUR TREND" or "HOURLY OUTLOOK", and peak summary like "High 30° at 14:00".
  - Interactive/smooth temperature line chart SVG with subtle gradient fill under the line, glowing warm dot at current/peak hour, small dots and temperature labels (e.g., 27°, 28°, 30°, 29°, 26°, 23°), hourly labels below (12:00, 15:00, 18:00, 21:00, 00:00, 03:00) and mini weather icon indicators.
- Card 2: "10-Day Forecast" List
  - Large frosted glass panel (28px rounded, white/24, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px white/50 border, p-5).
  - Header: "10-DAY FORECAST" label with calendar icon.
  - Rows for forecast days: "Today", "Sun, 25 Oct", "Mon, 26 Oct", "Tue, 27 Oct", "Wed, 28 Oct", "Thu, 29 Oct", "Fri, 30 Oct":
    - Day name column (bold/medium #0F2A4A, "Today" highlighted).
    - Weather condition icon: soft flat/3D puffy vector icon (sun #FFB238, cloud, rain drops).
    - Precipitation chance: e.g., "20%", "60%", "10%" in soft blue #2B78E4 with small droplet icon.
    - Low temp: e.g., "21°" in muted navy #4D6A8C.
    - Horizontal temperature range bar: rounded pill bar showing day's range with smooth gradient from soft sky blue #4FA3F7 to sun yellow #FFB238, indicating current temp or range relative to weekly min/max.
    - High temp: e.g., "30°" in bold navy #0F2A4A.
- Bottom Navigation Bar:
  - Floating frosted glass pill navigation docked at bottom (rounded-full, backdrop-blur-xl, border border-white/40).
  - 4 clean line icons: Home (wb_sunny / home), Forecast (calendar_today / timeline - ACTIVE with frosted circular active highlight), Cities / Map (location_city / map), Settings (tune / settings).
- Aesthetic Rules:
  - Strict glassmorphism: soft translucent white fills, crisp 1px borders (white/50), backdrop blur, no opaque harsh dark cards.
  - Weather icons are clean soft vector/SVG illustrations. No photos, no people, no real-world map satellite imagery.
screens.title: Nimbus - 10-Day Forecast

outputComponents.text:
I've created the **Nimbus Forecast** screen in the established glassmorphic Day Mode style:

- **Day Sky Gradient**: Smooth full-bleed background fading from vivid sky blue (`#4FA3F7`) through azure (`#8CCBFF`) to a warm peach horizon (`#FFD6A5`).
- **Header & Navigation**: Bold headline with a frosted segmented toggle (`Today` | `10 days`), where `10 days` is active with a bright translucent pill indicator.
- **24-Hour Outlook Card**: Frosted glass panel (28px rounded radius, white 24% fill, backdrop blur, and 1px 50% border) featuring a smooth temperature trend line with data point dots, hourly stamps, and condition icons.
- **10-Day Forecast Card**: Structured daily forecast list displaying day labels, vector condition icons, precipitation probability in blue, low/high temperatures, and horizontal gradient range bars (`#4FA3F7` to `#FFB238`).
- **Floating Bottom Bar**: Glass pill navigation with line icons for Home, Forecast (active with indicator), Map/Cities, and Settings.

screens.prompt:
Mobile weather app called "Nimbus" in glassmorphism style. Screen: CITIES / SEARCH.
Device: Mobile (390x844 viewport fit).
Background: Soft full-bleed sky gradient from vibrant sky blue (#4FA3F7) at the top through light cerulean (#8CCBFF) to a warm soft peach horizon (#FFD6A5) at the bottom.
Typography: Font Sora / Plus Jakarta Sans. Large thin temperature numerals (font-extralight / weight 200), bold headings, small uppercase tracking-wider labels. Deep navy ink (#0F2A4A) for primary text and headings, muted slate blue (#4D6A8C) for secondary details.
Styling: Frosted translucent glass cards (bg-white/25, backdrop-blur-xl, border border-white/50, rounded-[28px], soft shadow-lg shadow-black/5).

Layout details:
1. Top Status & Header:
   - iOS style status bar space.
   - Header bar with title "Cities" in bold navy font (text-2xl or 3xl font-bold text-[#0F2A4A]), and on the right a circular frosted glass plus button (+) with hover/tap feel.
2. Search Bar:
   - Frosted glass pill container (bg-white/30 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/60 rounded-full px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 shadow-sm).
   - Search icon, placeholder text "Search for a city" in #4D6A8C, with a subtle mic or filter icon.
3. Cities List (vertical stack of spacious frosted glass cards, rounded-[28px], p-5):
   - Card 1 (Active/Selected, "My Location" - slightly brighter glass bg-white/40 border-white/70):
     - Left side: "Bengaluru" bold text-xl text-[#0F2A4A], with a subtle location pin indicator "My Location" · "14:45", condition "Partly Cloudy", H: 30° L: 21°.
     - Right side: Weather visual (soft flat 3D-ish sun peeking behind fluffy white cloud, #FFB238 sun) and huge thin temperature "27°" in font-extralight text-4xl text-[#0F2A4A].
   - Card 2: "Mumbai"
     - "14:45", "Sunny & Humid", H: 33° L: 26°.
     - Sun icon #FFB238, temperature "32°".
   - Card 3: "Delhi"
     - "14:45", "Hazy Sunshine", H: 29° L: 18°.
     - Sun behind light haze cloud, temperature "28°".
   - Card 4: "London"
     - "09:15", "Light Rain", H: 16° L: 11°.
     - Cloud with soft blue raindrops, temperature "14°".
   - Card 5: "Tokyo"
     - "18:15", "Clear Night", H: 22° L: 15°.
     - Crescent moon with clear stars or soft night glow, temperature "19°".
4. Floating Bottom Nav Bar:
   - Frosted glass pill rounded-full (bg-white/30 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/50 shadow-xl px-6 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-around).
   - 4 destinations with clean line icons: Home (wb_sunny / home), Forecast (calendar / bar_chart), Cities (location_city / map / list - ACTIVE with illuminated circular pill highlight bg-white/50 or dot indicator), Settings (settings).
   - Content cleanly padded at bottom so the last card doesn't get covered by the floating nav.
screens.title: Nimbus - Cities & Search

outputComponents.text:
I've designed the **Cities & Search** screen for **Nimbus** in the Day mode glassmorphic aesthetic.

### Key Highlights:
- **Atmospheric Palette**: Full-bleed sky-to-peach horizon gradient (`#4FA3F7` → `#8CCBFF` → `#FFD6A5`).
- **Header & Search**: Bold "Cities" typography with a circular frosted glass `+` action button, accompanied by a pill search bar ("Search for a city").
- **Frosted Glass City Cards**: 28px rounded glass panels floating over the backdrop with 1px border reflections (`border-white/50`), featuring Bengaluru (highlighted/active location), Mumbai, Delhi, London, and Tokyo with local time, weather condition tags, custom minimalist weather icons, High/Low ranges, and large thin temperature numerals.
- **Floating Navigation Bar**: Glass pill bottom bar with active indicator on the Cities navigation destination, maintaining visual harmony with the Current Weather and 10-Day Forecast screens.

screens.prompt:
Mobile weather app called "Nimbus", GLASSMORPHISM style. DAY mode: full-bleed soft sky gradient #4FA3F7 (top) -> #8CCBFF -> warm peach horizon #FFD6A5 (bottom). 
Content strictly fits a 390x844 viewport (iOS style, 9:41 status bar at top).
NO bottom nav bar.

Top bar / Header:
- Top bar with back button icon (rounded frosted pill or circle button `arrow_back`), title "Bengaluru", and subtitle / badge "Details". Trailing icon for share or info.
- Typography: Deep navy ink #0F2A4A, muted #4D6A8C. Headings bold Sora / sans-serif, small uppercase labels with wide tracking (tracking-wider / tracking-widest).

Cards & Tiles (all frosted glass: background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24), backdrop-filter blur(20px), 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5), rounded-[28px], soft shadow):

1. 2-column grid of frosted glass tiles:
- AIR QUALITY tile:
  - Header: small uppercase label "AIR QUALITY" with air icon.
  - Big bold number "42" and status tag "Good" in green / navy.
  - Horizontal colorful spectrum AQI bar (linear gradient from emerald green #10B981 -> yellow #FBBF24 -> orange #F97316 -> red #EF4444) with a distinct white dot marker positioned around 25%.
  - Subtext: "Air quality is ideal for outdoor activities."

- UV INDEX tile:
  - Header: small uppercase label "UV INDEX" with wb_sunny icon.
  - Big value "6" with badge "High" (warm amber #FFB238).
  - Horizontal mini gradient bar (green to purple) with indicator dot.
  - Subtext: "Protection required until 17:00."

- WIND tile:
  - Header: small uppercase label "WIND" with air / navigation icon.
  - Visual: Elegant circular compass dial / ring with directional marks (N, E, S, W) and an active indicator needle pointing NE.
  - Value: "12 km/h" and "NE" in deep navy.
  - Subtext: "Gusts up to 18 km/h".

- HUMIDITY tile:
  - Header: small uppercase label "HUMIDITY" with water_drop icon.
  - Big value "64%".
  - Secondary detail: "The dew point is 19° right now."

2. Wide full-width SUNRISE & SUNSET tile:
  - Header: uppercase label "SUNRISE & SUNSET" with wb_twilight icon.
  - Centerpiece visual: Dashed semicircle arc (SVG) spanning across with horizon line, and a glowing warm sun dot (#FFB238) positioned along the current progress of the arc.
  - Left side: "Sunrise" "06:12", Right side: "Sunset" "18:04".
  - Bottom indicator: "Daylight remaining: 3h 18m".

3. 2-column grid continuation:
- FEELS LIKE tile:
  - Header: uppercase label "FEELS LIKE" with thermostat icon.
  - Huge thin numeral "29°" (Sora / light weight).
  - Subtext: "Humidity makes it feel slightly warmer."

- PRESSURE tile:
  - Header: uppercase label "PRESSURE" with speed / compress icon.
  - Value "1012 hPa".
  - Small indicator or needle reading "Steady".

Style Details:
- Deep navy ink #0F2A4A, muted secondary text #4D6A8C.
- Clean vector icons, no photography, strictly glassmorphic Day Sky palette.
- Spacing and padding optimized so all primary details fit cleanly without scroll or overflow inside 390x844.
screens.title: Nimbus - Weather Details

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the **Weather Details** screen for **Nimbus** in Day Mode, staying strictly true to the glassmorphic design system:

### Key Design Details:
- **Atmospheric Palette & Sky Gradient**: Set against the signature day sky gradient (`#4FA3F7` down through `#8CCBFF` to warm peach horizon `#FFD6A5`).
- **Glassmorphic Cards**: Floating 28px rounded frosted glass tiles with a 24% translucent white fill, 1px soft white border, and subtle drop shadows.
- **Header**: Features a back action button, location label ("Bengaluru"), a frosted "DETAILS" capsule badge, and search shortcut.
- **Metric Tiles**:
  - **Air Quality**: Large display numeral "42", "Good" badge, and full spectrum AQI progress bar with active position indicator.
  - **UV Index**: "6 High" metric with gradient exposure bar and recommendation footnote.
  - **Wind**: Styled with "12 km/h NE" metric accompanied by a clean vector compass rosette.
  - **Humidity**: Prominent "64%" reading with dew point calculation and progress fill.
  - **Sunrise & Sunset Wide Tile**: Featuring an integrated dashed solar trajectory arc with real-time glowing sun progress dot, countdown badge, and solar noon markers.
  - **Feels Like & Pressure**: Large thin-stemmed numeral "29°" and "1012 hPa Steady" status indicator.
- **Viewport Optimization**: Custom fitted to the 390×844 mobile frame with no bottom navigation bar, as specified.
